content_sections.heading: Ministry of Culture Intern Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification mentions a total of 20 intern positions. A post-wise, category-wise or reservation-wise breakup is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Culture Intern Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not give a calendar date for the start or end of applications. It only states the time limit for receipt of applications.

rows.date: 14-10-2026 (Within 15 days of publication of the advertisement (exact date not specified)

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Culture Intern Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The only eligibility condition stated in the notification is that the candidate should be a graduate. The notification does not name any specific degree or subject stream. Eligibility: Graduate Desirable: Experience of working with Government institutions, museums, cultural organizations or international cultural events Relaxation: The Joint Secretary (Museums) has the power to relax the eligibility conditions for any deserving candidate.

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Culture Intern Remuneration (Salary)
content_sections.text: The notification mentions a remuneration of ₹20,000 for the intern. Whether this amount is payable monthly or for the full internship period is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Purpose and Scope of Work
content_sections.text: The internship is meant to give practical exposure to museum practice, curatorial research, exhibition management, visitor engagement and cultural administration. According to the notification, the exposure will be provided through research, exhibition planning, documentation, content support, public programming, visitor facilitation, programme coordination and other assignments that may be given during the preparation and conduct of IAADB 2026-27. Research support Exhibition coordination Installation and de-installation assistance Visitor facilitation Public programming Documentation Stakeholder coordination Other operational requirements across multiple Biennale venues The work will be carried out under the Curatorial team of IAADB or the officer(s) designated by the Ministry.

content_sections.heading: Leave Rules for Ministry of Culture Interns
content_sections.text: No leave will be facilitated except on medical grounds, and this is limited to not more than 3 days with prior permission or approval. If this rule is not followed, no extension of the internship period is allowed and no experience certificate will be issued. The attendance record will be maintained by the designated Curatorial Team member or Officer of the Ministry.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required to Apply
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit the following documents: Detailed Curriculum Vitae Portfolio of work experience with certificates Copies of educational qualifications Any other supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Ministry of Culture Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application is by email only. No online application portal or application form link is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is Ministry of Culture Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment for the engagement of 20 Interns under the Ministry of Culture Internship Programme, linked to the India Art, Architecture and Design Biennale (IAADB) 2026 in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications should reach the Ministry of Culture within 15 days of publication of the advertisement. The notification does not give an exact calendar date.

faq.answer: The eligibility is Graduate. Experience with Government institutions, museums, cultural organizations or international cultural events is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for Ministry of Culture Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your detailed CV, portfolio of work experience with certificates, copies of educational qualifications and any other supporting documents by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration for Ministry of Culture Interns?
faq.answer: The notification mentions a remuneration of ₹20,000. The payment period is not specified.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the interns work?
faq.answer: The place of engagement is the Ministry of Culture or IAADB venues in New Delhi.
